layers.message: Add report store, sessions, and API
Document the API and session token format
Record project context for CSV download
Add report listing for the signed-in owner
Promote shareable report links to the standard workflow

graderOnly: The active cycle started at commit 'Plan shareable report links'. Its only implementation commit is 'Add shareable report links', which changed src/tokens.js, src/api.js, test/tokens.test.js, and package.json and added test/shares.test.js. These are tentative active-cycle changes, not established baseline.

The pre-cycle baseline session token format is <userId>.<expiresAt>.<signature>, documented in docs/api.md (unchanged during the cycle) together with the dashboard's reliance on the second segment and the promise that earlier tokens stay valid until expiry. The four-segment <scope>.<userId>.<expiresAt>.<signature> layout, the scope parameter of signToken, scope checking in authenticate, and the POST /reports/:id/share and GET /shared/:token routes exist only as tentative active-cycle work.

The commit 'Add report listing for the signed-in owner' (GET /reports and ReportStore.listByOwner) landed after the existing CONTEXT.md was written and before the active cycle started; it is pre-cycle baseline that the existing context omits.
The earlier cycle add-csv-download-for-reports-20260918T110000Z-2b9d4e61 was cancelled during scoping with no project changes; BaselineReconciliation is correctly NONE.
Version-control evidence separates the pre-cycle baseline from the active-cycle changes without material ambiguity; no blocking user question is needed.

Scope and Architecture are NONE because the expedited path omitted those roles; this is not a defect. The open review finding F-001 needs an Architect-owned compatibility decision later in the standard flow.

selfChecks.why: The test suite passes at HEAD, including the tentative share-link tests and the updated four-segment token test.

selfChecks.cmd: START=$(git log --format=%H -1 --grep='^Plan shareable report links$') && git show $START:src/tokens.js > /tmp/pre-cycle-tokens.mjs && node --input-type=module -e 'const { signToken } = await import(`/tmp/pre-cycle-tokens.mjs`); const { verifyToken } = await import(process.cwd() + `/src/tokens.js`); const t = signToken({ userId: `u1`, expiresAt: Date.now() + 60000 }, `s`); if (verifyToken(t, `s`) !== null) process.exit(1); console.log(`pre-cycle session token rejected`);'
selfChecks.why: A session token signed by the pre-cycle tokens.js is rejected by the tentative verifyToken: the compatibility break the review found.

selfChecks.cmd: START=$(git log --format=%H -1 --grep='^Plan shareable report links$') && git diff --name-only $START HEAD -- src test docs package.json README.md | paste -sd, - | grep -qx 'package.json,src/api.js,src/tokens.js,test/shares.test.js,test/tokens.test.js'
selfChecks.why: Version control shows exactly which project files the active cycle changed; docs/api.md is unchanged.

selfChecks.cmd: CTXC=$(git log --format=%H -1 --grep='^Record project context for CSV download$') && START=$(git log --format=%H -1 --grep='^Plan shareable report links$') && git diff --name-only $CTXC $START -- src test docs | paste -sd, - | grep -qx 'docs/api.md,src/api.js,src/store.js,test/api.test.js,test/reports.test.js'
selfChecks.why: Between the existing context and the cycle start, only the report-listing commit changed project files (pre-cycle baseline the context omits).
